query: WITH ended AS (UPDATE agents SET revoked_at = $3 WHERE sign_in_method = 'oidc' AND oidc_org_id = $1 AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR user_id = $2) AND revoked_at IS NULL RETURNING id), tokens AS (UPDATE agent_tokens t SET revoked_at = $3 FROM ended e WHERE t.agent_id = e.id AND t.revoked_at IS NULL) SELECT count(*) AS "ended!" FROM ended
